prompt_md: At 6 o'clock a clock strikes 6 times, and 5 seconds pass from the first strike to the last. At 12 o'clock, how many seconds from the first strike to the last?
prompt_short: 6 strikes take 5 s, first to last. How long for 12 strikes?
hint_md: The time lives in the gaps between strikes.
explain_intuition_md: Six strikes have only 5 gaps between them, so each gap is 1 second. Twelve strikes have 11 gaps. Doubling to 10 counts strikes instead of gaps.
